links.to_node: The new dam is not constructed.
The local ecosystems and wildlife are not disrupted by dam construction.
The major energy company proceeds with building the coal-fired power plant.
The region experiences continued reliance on coal-fired power for energy.
Energy costs and taxes in the region remain higher than they would with the dam.
Air pollution and environmental damage from coal power plant emissions occur.
Public health may be negatively impacted by coal plant pollution.
The region does not benefit from the increased energy efficiency of hydroelectric power.
